task_description: Transform the species-on-screen website from a scroll-driven experience with a decorative globe into a globe-first immersive interface. The globe becomes the full-viewport app. Floating glass cards appear at species locations. Clicking a card triggers a cinematic zoom-into-habitat transition revealing a virtual safari scene with parallax storytelling and comic strip science communication. Architecture supports arbitrary species, not just 10.

verification.summary: npm run build succeeds (exit 0, dist/ produced with all assets). All 10 species JSON files validated with safari_scene and comic_strip fields. Semantic review v1 found 7 issues, 6 fixed (CSS injection sanitization, scroll position reset, transition error handling, globe inertia zeroing, memory optimization via cached data, floating cards race condition). Issue 7 (texture CDN failure) assessed as acceptable with existing fallback. Build verified after fixes.
